values.pain-points: Their finance team rebuilds our monthly report in a spreadsheet, because they can’t split costs by depot.
values.notes: “I spend the first two days of every month copying numbers.” They tried filtering by depot, but the totals didn’t match the invoice.
feature-requests: [ ] Export that matches the invoice line by line

values.open-questions: Do depots change during a month? If one is renamed, which name does the report show?
values.decision: Version one covers the current month and the six before it. Older months stay in the existing report, so we don’t need to rebuild history.

values.highlights: Depot reporting is in beta with four customers. The new onboarding is ready for the 3 November launch.
values.risks: The billing export needs the data team, who are busy with the year-end close until mid-November.
next-steps: [ ] Agree a smaller first version of the billing export
[ ] Share the beta results with sales

values.update: Teams that finish the new onboarding come back in week two more often. Not enough of them finish it yet.
values.blockers: The onboarding emails can’t go out until the legal review is done.

values.what-worked: The in-app tip on the filters bar did most of the work. Most saved filters were made the day someone saw it.
values.what-wed-change: Ask five customers to try it in staging first. Two of the top requests in week one were things they would have told us.

values.theme: People can’t find past invoices once they change plans.
values.evidence: “Where did my September invoice go?” came up in 9 tickets. Two customers in interviews said they keep their own copies now, just in case.
action: [ ] Show all invoices, whatever the plan
[ ] Ask support for the ticket links to add to the spec
